description: Find tours, attractions, activities, day trips and things to do — just describe what you want in plain language. For example: "A small-group food tour in Rome on Saturday evening for two adults under EUR 150." Adin Experiences can use the trip details you provide — such as destination, dates, group size, hotel area, arrival time or free time — to surface experiences that fit your plans. Results can include current provider content such as ratings, reviews, prices, duration, photos and cancellation terms. Compare options in the chat, ask follow-up questions, then continue to Viator to confirm final availability and price and complete your booking. Adin Experiences does not process payment inside ChatGPT.
